scope: Proposed short button/action labels and four context-qualified game labels only.

selection_constraints.actions: Exact English action labels in verified interaction/button fields; never replace matching words inside prose or noun-only titles.
selection_constraints.Staff: Verified weapon label fields only; not employees or NPC occupations.
selection_constraints.Snipe: Exact Snipe skill-name fields only; not the bird in prose.
selection_constraints.Bound: Item binding flag only; not book binding or an English verb.

style: Uses common local interface conventions. Russian predominantly uses infinitives; Japanese and Korean use short interface labels. A Turkish imperative style is not imposed globally.

locale_limitations.zh: Simplified Chinese only. Do not apply to zh-TW, zh-HK or any Traditional Chinese locale.
locale_limitations.pt: General Portuguese labels; not a reviewed regional Portuguese localization.
locale_limitations.ar: Labels are Unicode Arabic. Right-to-left layout, shaping and game-font support require separate in-game verification.

disclaimer: This lexicon improves these explicit labels only. It does not establish translation quality for generated sentences, mechanics, quests, subtitles or an entire language pack.
